day_summary: BOND DISTRIBUTION DAY 3 — STEP ASIDE UNCHANGED AT HIGH CONVICTION. Premarket: SPCX estimated $155–$158 range (slight lift on NQ futures +2.1% / Qualcomm Dragonfly data center debut + Micron $50B Q4 AI demand confirmation). The bond distribution supply overhang from the $20B SpaceX inaugural offering (June 22, $89B demand, 4.4x oversubscribed) is in day 3 of the estimated 10–12 business day clearance window. Distribution clears ~July 1–6. Despite the strongest single-day AI fundamental session of the 2026 cycle (NQ +2.1%, MU +16%, QCOM +12%, SK Hynix +11.1%), SPCX is NOT clearing the $185 re-entry gate — current $155–$158 premarket is $27–$30 below Day 1 trigger. June 24 proved the pattern: Micron AH $50B guide → $159.86 SPCX intraday → $154.54 closing, -1.01% on the day. The distribution mechanics absorbed the best AI catalyst of the cycle. Step aside through ~July 6. PCE at 8:30 AM ET (12:30 UTC) is the session macro catalyst — cold PCE could bid SPCX toward $160–$165 (does NOT unlock re-entry). Re-entry gate: two consecutive daily closes above $185 on above-average volume.

analysis:
## Technical analysis

**Trend:** SPCX confirmed bond distribution supply pattern June 24: best AI catalyst of 2026 cycle (Micron $50B Q4 guide AH) → $159.86 intraday → $154.54 close (-1.01%). Pattern: distribution supply absorbs every recovery bid. June 25 premarket: est. $155–$158 on NQ +2.1% / Qualcomm Dragonfly debut — same absorption dynamic expected.

**Distribution mechanics:** Day 3 of est. 10–12 business day window from June 22 $20B bond offering. $89B demand (4.4x oversubscribed) validates franchise quality but creates cross-asset rebalancing selling pressure as institutional bond allocants adjust equity exposures. Volume above 8M shares confirms active distribution; normalization below 5M shares (~July 1–6) is the clearance signal.

**Key levels:** $150 IG defense line tested intraday June 23 ($147.11 all-time low) and June 24 ($150.72 low) — closed above both times. Three closes in a row approaching $150 intraday. Hot PCE creates highest-risk scenario for a closing breach. $185 gate requires +19.7% from $154.54 — only achievable post-distribution clearance.

**Re-entry framework:** (1) Two consecutive daily closes above $185 on above-average volume required. (2) Bond distribution clearance (~July 1–6) is prerequisite. (3) September 2 first earnings is the structural catalyst. (4) No intraday or single-close signals count.
